plugin.name: Solao_Loot_Tracker
plugin.author: Solao
plugin.purpose: Records mob loot (item, mob, zone, room) into a searchable SQLite database

muclient.script:
require "gmcphelper" require "json" -- json.encode / json.decode (bundled) local ok_colors = pcall(require, "aardwolf_colors") -- StylesToColours pcall(function () async = require "async" end) -- global; async HTTP for the share API
local TITLE = "Loot Tracker" local PVER = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 19) or "?"
-- shared loot-pool service. Baked in, not user-changeable. local API_URL = "https://api.aardwolf.muds.fyi"
local DBFILE local db
local function trim (s) return (s or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","") end local function q (s) return "'" .. tostring(s or ""):gsub("'", "''") .. "'" end
-- 'get from' can be a room resource (a bush, a chest) OR your own bag. We only -- want room resources, so any source containing one of these words is treated as -- a personal container and ignored. Editable with 'loot bags add|del'. local exclude = {} local EXCLUDE_DEFAULT = "bag,backpack,pouch,sack,satchel,purse,quiver,holding,pack,wallet,keyring" local function load_exclude () exclude = {} for word in (GetVariable("bags") or EXCLUDE_DEFAULT):gmatch("[^,]+") do local w = trim(word):lower() if w ~= "" then exclude[w] = true end end end local function save_exclude () local t = {}; for w in pairs(exclude) do t[#t+1] = w end table.sort(t); SetVariable("bags", table.concat(t, ",")) end local function is_bag (source) local low = source:lower() for w in pairs(exclude) do if low:find(w, 1, true) then return true end end return false end
-- the reliable check: your inventory containers, read live from invdata (rename- -- proof). {invitem}serial,flags,shortdesc,type... where type 11 == a container. -- my_bags[shortdesc:lower()] = true. A source you 'get from' that is one of these -- is your own bag; anything else is a room object. local my_bags = {} function on_invitem (name, line, wildcards) local parts = {} for p in (wildcards[1] .. ","):gmatch("(.-),") do parts[#parts+1] = p end local n = #parts if n < 7 then return end -- serial,flags,desc,level,type,+3 values if tonumber(parts[n-3]) ~= 11 then return end -- type field; 11 = container only local d = {} for i = 3, n - 5 do d[#d+1] = parts[i] end -- desc may itself contain commas local desc = trim(table.concat(d, ",")) if desc ~= "" then my_bags[desc:lower()] = true end end
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- database ------------------------------------------------------------------ local function opendb () db = sqlite3.open(DBFILE) db:exec [[ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loot ( item TEXT NOT NULL, item_color TEXT, mob TEXT NOT NULL, zone TEXT, roomid INTEGER, room TEXT, count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_seen INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (item, mob) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop_stock ( item TEXT NOT NULL, item_color TEXT, keeper TEXT, zone TEXT, roomid INTEGER, room TEXT, price INTEGER, level INTEGER, last_seen INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (item, roomid) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS targets ( mob TEXT NOT NULL, area TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (mob, area) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gathered ( item TEXT NOT NULL, item_color TEXT, source TEXT NOT NULL, zone TEXT, roomid INTEGER, room TEXT, count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_seen INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (item, source, roomid) ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_loot_item ON loot(item); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_loot_mob ON loot(mob); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shop_item ON shop_stock(item); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_targ_mob ON targets(mob); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gath_item ON gathered(item); ]] -- upgrade older DBs (each ALTER is a no-op-or-error if the column exists) for _, a in ipairs({ "ALTER TABLE shop_stock ADD COLUMN level INTEGER;", "ALTER TABLE loot ADD COLUMN item_color TEXT;", "ALTER TABLE shop_stock ADD COLUMN item_color TEXT;", }) do pcall(function () db:exec(a) end) end end
-- pull the coloured (@-coded) run of the item out of a matched line's styles local function colored_from (styles, pat) if not (ok_colors and StylesToColours) then return "" end local ok, full = pcall(StylesToColours, styles) if not ok or type(full) ~= "string" then return "" end return trim(full:match(pat) or "") end
-- current room from GMCP local function room_now () return trim(gmcp("room.info.zone") or ""), tonumber(gmcp("room.info.num")) or 0, trim(gmcp("room.info.name") or "") end
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- capture ------------------------------------------------------------------ function on_loot (name, line, wildcards, styles) local item, mob = trim(wildcards[1]), trim(wildcards[2]) if item:match("^[%d,]+ gold coins?$") then return end -- gold isn't loot (commas too) if item == "" or mob == "" then return end -- mob short-descs always lead with an article (a/an/the); player corpses are a -- bare name. No article == a player corpse -> don't record PK loot. local low = mob:lower() if not (low:match("^a ") or low:match("^an ") or low:match("^the ")) then return end
local citem = colored_from(styles, "You get%s+(.-)%s+from the") -- @-coded item local zone, roomid, room = room_now() -- insert-if-new then bump, so it works on any SQLite version (no UPSERT needed) db:exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO loot (item,item_color,mob,zone,roomid,room,count,last_seen) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%d,%s,0,%d);", q(item), q(citem), q(mob), q(zone), roomid, q(room), os.time())) db:exec(string.format( "UPDATE loot SET count=count+1, zone=%s, roomid=%d, room=%s, last_seen=%d WHERE item=%s AND mob=%s;", q(zone), roomid, q(room), os.time(), q(item), q(mob))) if citem ~= "" then db:exec(string.format("UPDATE loot SET item_color=%s WHERE item=%s AND mob=%s;", q(citem), q(item), q(mob))) end end
-- native shop stock ('---' Qty). Keyed on (item, roomid) so re-listing updates price. function on_shop (name, line, wildcards, styles) local item = trim(wildcards[3]) if item == "" then return end local citem = colored_from(styles, "%-%-%-%s+(.+)$") -- @-coded item after the Qty dashes local zone, roomid, room = room_now() local lv, pr = tonumber(wildcards[1]) or 0, tonumber(wildcards[2]) or 0 db:exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO shop_stock (item,item_color,keeper,zone,roomid,room,price,level,last_seen) VALUES (%s,%s,'',%s,%d,%s,%d,%d,%d);", q(item), q(citem), q(zone), roomid, q(room), pr, lv, os.time())) db:exec(string.format( "UPDATE shop_stock SET price=%d, level=%d, zone=%s, room=%s, last_seen=%d WHERE item=%s AND roomid=%d;", pr, lv, q(zone), q(room), os.time(), q(item), roomid)) if citem ~= "" then db:exec(string.format("UPDATE shop_stock SET item_color=%s WHERE item=%s AND roomid=%d;", q(citem), q(item), roomid)) end end
-- write one gathered row (item from a room source, keyed on item+source+room) local function record_gather (item, citem, source) local zone, roomid, room = room_now() db:exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO gathered (item,item_color,source,zone,roomid,room,count,last_seen) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%d,%s,0,%d);", q(item), q(citem), q(source), q(zone), roomid, q(room), os.time())) db:exec(string.format( "UPDATE gathered SET count=count+1, zone=%s, room=%s, last_seen=%d WHERE item=%s AND source=%s AND roomid=%d;", q(zone), q(room), os.time(), q(item), q(source), roomid)) if citem ~= "" then db:exec(string.format("UPDATE gathered SET item_color=%s WHERE item=%s AND source=%s AND roomid=%d;", q(citem), q(item), q(source), roomid)) end return roomid, zone, room end
-- 'loot here' flow: send a get, then catch its "You get <item>." to record the -- full item name (+ colour) as a floor spawn at the current room. local here_pending = false local function here_disarm () here_pending = false; EnableTrigger("here_catch", false); DeleteTimer("here_timeout") end
function on_here_catch (name, line, wildcards, styles) if not here_pending then return end local item = trim(wildcards[1]) if item:find(" from ", 1, true) then return end -- a container get slipped in; keep waiting here_disarm() if item:match("^[%d,]+ gold coins?$") then ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": that was gold, not recorded."); return end local citem = colored_from(styles, "You get%s+(.-)%s*%.$") local roomid, _, room = record_gather(item, citem, "the ground") ColourNote("green","", "Recorded '"..item.."' on the ground in "..(room ~= "" and room or "?").." ("..roomid..").") end
function here_timeout () if here_pending then here_disarm(); ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": no pickup seen -- is the item here? Nothing recorded.") end end
-- room-resource gather: "You get <item> from <source>" where source is a room -- object (bush, chest, desk...), NOT a corpse and NOT one of your own containers. function on_get (name, line, wildcards, styles) local item, source = trim(wildcards[1]), trim(wildcards[2]) if item == "" or source == "" then return end if item:match("^[%d,]+ gold coins?$") then return end -- gold if source:lower():find("corpse", 1, true) then return end -- corpse loot handled by on_loot if my_bags[source:lower()] then return end -- a container you carry (invdata) if is_bag(source) then return end -- word-list fallback for bags record_gather(item, colored_from(styles, "You get%s+(.-)%s+from "), source) end
-- campaign/quest goal target: mob -> area (quest-spawned mobs S&D never scans) function on_target (mob, area) mob, area = trim(mob), trim(area) if mob == "" or area == "" then return end db:exec(string.format("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO targets (mob,area,last_seen) VALUES (%s,%s,%d);", q(mob), q(area), os.time())) db:exec(string.format("UPDATE targets SET last_seen=%d WHERE mob=%s AND area=%s;", os.time(), q(mob), q(area))) end
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- queries (local commands) ------------------------------------------------------------------ local function count_of (tbl) for row in db:nrows("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM " .. tbl) do return row.n end return 0 end
local function show_item (term) term = trim(term) if term == "" then ColourNote("silver","","Usage: loot item <text>"); return end local sql = string.format( "SELECT item,mob,zone,roomid,room,count FROM loot WHERE item LIKE %s ORDER BY item, count DESC", q("%"..term.."%")) local n = 0 for r in db:nrows(sql) do n = n + 1 ColourNote("cyan","", r.item) ColourNote("white","", string.format(" from %s in %s -- %s (%d) x%d", r.mob, r.zone ~= "" and r.zone or "?", r.room ~= "" and r.room or "?", r.roomid, r.count)) end if n == 0 then ColourNote("silver","","No looted item matching '"..term.."'.") end end
local function show_mob (term) term = trim(term) if term == "" then ColourNote("silver","","Usage: loot mob <text>"); return end local sql = string.format( "SELECT mob,item,zone,roomid,room,count FROM loot WHERE mob LIKE %s ORDER BY mob, count DESC", q("%"..term.."%")) local n = 0 for r in db:nrows(sql) do n = n + 1 ColourNote("cyan","", r.mob.." ("..(r.zone ~= "" and r.zone or "?").." -- "..(r.room ~= "" and r.room or "?").." "..(r.roomid or 0)..")") ColourNote("white","", string.format(" drops %s x%d", r.item, r.count)) end if n == 0 then ColourNote("silver","","No mob drops matching '"..term.."'.") end end
local function show_shop (term) term = trim(term) if term == "" then ColourNote("silver","","Usage: loot shop <text>"); return end local sql = string.format( "SELECT item,zone,roomid,room,price,level FROM shop_stock WHERE item LIKE %s ORDER BY price", q("%"..term.."%")) local n = 0 for r in db:nrows(sql) do n = n + 1 ColourNote("cyan","", r.item) ColourNote("white","", string.format(" %d gold (lvl %d) @ %s -- %s (%d)", r.price or 0, r.level or 0, r.zone ~= "" and r.zone or "?", r.room ~= "" and r.room or "?", r.roomid)) end if n == 0 then ColourNote("silver","","No shop stock matching '"..term.."'.") end end
-- remove rows by item name (optionally scoped to one room id) from every item table local function del_item (rest) rest = trim(rest) if rest == "" then ColourNote("silver","","Usage: loot del <item> [roomid] (roomid scopes to that one room)"); return end local item, roomid = rest, nil local id = rest:match("%s(%d+)$") -- trailing " <number>" = a room id if id then item = trim(rest:sub(1, #rest - #id)); roomid = tonumber(id) end
local cond = "item LIKE " .. q("%"..item.."%") if roomid then cond = cond .. " AND roomid = " .. roomid end local total = 0 for _, t in ipairs({ {"loot","loot"}, {"shop_stock","shop"}, {"gathered","gathered"} }) do local n = 0 for r in db:nrows("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "..t[1].." WHERE "..cond) do n = r.n end if n > 0 then db:exec("DELETE FROM "..t[1].." WHERE "..cond) ColourNote("white","", " "..t[2]..": removed "..n) total = total + n end end if total == 0 then ColourNote("silver","","No rows matching '"..item.."'"..(roomid and (" in room "..roomid) or "")..".") else ColourNote("green","","Deleted "..total.." row(s) matching '"..item.."'"..(roomid and (" in room "..roomid) or "")..".") end end
local function show_gathered (term) term = trim(term) local where = term ~= "" and (" WHERE item LIKE "..q("%"..term.."%").." OR source LIKE "..q("%"..term.."%")) or "" local n = 0 for r in db:nrows("SELECT item,source,zone,roomid,room,count FROM gathered"..where.." ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 40") do n = n + 1 ColourNote("cyan","", r.item) ColourNote("white","", string.format(" from %s in %s -- %s (%d) x%d", r.source, r.zone ~= "" and r.zone or "?", r.room ~= "" and r.room or "?", r.roomid, r.count)) end if n == 0 then ColourNote("silver","","No gathered items"..(term ~= "" and " matching '"..term.."'." or " yet.")) end end
local function show_bags (rest) local sub, w = rest:match("^(%S*)%s*(.*)$") sub, w = (sub or ""):lower(), trim(w or ""):lower() if sub == "add" and w ~= "" then exclude[w] = true; save_exclude(); ColourNote("green","","Ignoring gather sources matching '"..w.."'.") elseif sub == "del" and w ~= "" then exclude[w] = nil; save_exclude(); ColourNote("green","","No longer ignoring '"..w.."'.") else local carried = {}; for x in pairs(my_bags) do carried[#carried+1] = x end; table.sort(carried) ColourNote("cyan","","Containers you carry (from invdata, rename-proof):") ColourNote("white",""," "..(#carried > 0 and table.concat(carried, ", ") or "(none seen yet -- type 'inv')")) local t = {}; for x in pairs(exclude) do t[#t+1] = x end; table.sort(t) ColourNote("cyan","","Fallback word-list (source containing any = ignored):") ColourNote("white",""," "..table.concat(t, ", ")) ColourNote("silver","","loot bags add <word> | loot bags del <word>") end end
local function show_goals (term) term = trim(term) local where = term ~= "" and (" WHERE mob LIKE "..q("%"..term.."%").." OR area LIKE "..q("%"..term.."%")) or "" local n = 0 for r in db:nrows("SELECT mob,area FROM targets"..where.." ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 40") do n = n + 1 ColourNote("white","", string.format(" %-32s -> %s", r.mob, r.area)) end if n == 0 then ColourNote("silver","","No goal targets recorded"..(term ~= "" and " matching '"..term.."'." or " yet.")) end end
local function show_recent () local n = 0 for r in db:nrows("SELECT item,mob,zone,last_seen FROM loot ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 15") do n = n + 1 ColourNote("white","", string.format(" %-30s <- %-24s (%s)", r.item, r.mob, r.zone ~= "" and r.zone or "?")) end if n == 0 then ColourNote("silver","","Nothing recorded yet.") end end
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- command dispatch ------------------------------------------------------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------ -- share the DB out-of-band (file), so clans can pool data with zero game traffic ------------------------------------------------------------------ local SHARE_COLS = { loot = {"item","item_color","mob","zone","roomid","room","count","last_seen"}, shop_stock = {"item","item_color","keeper","zone","roomid","room","price","level","last_seen"}, gathered = {"item","item_color","source","zone","roomid","room","count","last_seen"}, targets = {"mob","area","last_seen"}, } local SHARE_ORDER = { "loot", "shop_stock", "gathered", "targets" }
-- serialize the whole DB to the shared TSV format (also the HTTP wire body) -- serialize the whole DB to a JSON object: { <table> = [ {col=val,...}, ... ], ... } -- this is both the file format and the HTTP wire body. local function serialize_db () local data, rows = {}, 0 for _, tbl in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do local cols, arr = SHARE_COLS[tbl], {} for r in db:nrows("SELECT "..table.concat(cols, ",").." FROM "..tbl) do local o = {} for _, c in ipairs(cols) do o[c] = r[c] end arr[#arr+1] = o; rows = rows + 1 end data[tbl] = arr end return json.encode(data), rows end
-- merge a shared JSON dump into the DB (existing rows kept). returns added, seen local function merge_dump (text) local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, tostring(text or "")) if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0, 0 end local before, seen = db:total_changes(), 0 db:exec("BEGIN") for _, tbl in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do local cols, arr = SHARE_COLS[tbl], data[tbl] if type(arr) == "table" then for _, o in ipairs(arr) do if type(o) == "table" then local qs = {} for _, c in ipairs(cols) do local v = o[c]; qs[#qs+1] = q(v == nil and "" or v) end db:exec("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "..tbl.." ("..table.concat(cols, ",")..") VALUES ("..table.concat(qs, ",")..")") seen = seen + 1 end end end end db:exec("COMMIT") return db:total_changes() - before, seen end
local function do_export (fn) fn = trim(fn); if fn == "" then fn = "SolaoLoot-share.json" end local path = GetInfo(66) .. fn local f = io.open(path, "w") if not f then ColourNote("red","", TITLE..": can't write "..path); return end local body, rows = serialize_db() f:write(body); f:close() ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": exported "..rows.." rows -> "..path) ColourNote("silver","", "Share that file out-of-band (Discord / git). Others: loot import "..fn) end
local function do_import (fn) fn = trim(fn) if fn == "" then ColourNote("silver","","Usage: loot import <file> (merge a shared export; existing rows kept)"); return end local f = io.open(GetInfo(66) .. fn, "r") if not f then ColourNote("red","", TITLE..": can't read "..fn); return end local text = f:read("*a"); f:close() local added, seen = merge_dump(text) ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": imported "..fn.." -- "..added.." new row(s) ("..seen.." read, duplicates kept).") end
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- shared API service (default off). 'loot api <url>' sets the endpoint, then -- 'loot auth' registers this character and stores the key (never shown). upload -- pushes your DB; update pulls + merges the pool. Straight HTTP, no game traffic. -- POST <api>/auth JSON {"name":..} -> JSON {"key":..} -- POST <api>/loot x-api-key, JSON dump -> server merges it in -- GET <api>/loot x-api-key -> JSON pooled dump -- (JSON body shape: { loot=[{col:val,..},..], shop_stock=[..], gathered=[..], targets=[..] }) ------------------------------------------------------------------ local function api_url () return API_URL end local function auth_key () return trim(GetVariable("authkey") or "") end
local function need_api () if api_url() == "" then ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": sharing is disabled in this build."); return false end if not async then ColourNote("red","", TITLE..": async library missing; can't reach the API."); return false end return true end local function need_auth () if auth_key() == "" then ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": not authenticated -- run 'loot auth' first."); return false end return true end
-- register this character with the pool; the API returns a key we store hidden local function do_auth () if auth_key() ~= "" then ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": already authenticated as "..(GetVariable("authname") or "?")..".") return end if not need_api() then return end local name = trim(gmcp("char.base.name") or "") if name == "" then name = trim(utils.inputbox("Character name to register with the loot pool:", TITLE, "") or "") end if name == "" then ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": auth cancelled."); return end local body = json.encode({ name = name }) local req = { method = "POST", source = body, headers = { ["content-type"] = "application/json", ["content-length"] = tostring(#body) } } ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": registering '"..name.."'...") async.doAsyncRemoteRequest(api_url().."/auth", function (rc, page, status) local key if type(page) == "string" then local ok, t = pcall(json.decode, page); if ok and type(t) == "table" then key = t.key end end if status == 200 and key and trim(key) ~= "" then SetVariable("authkey", trim(key)) -- kept in plugin state, never displayed SetVariable("authname", name) ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": authenticated as "..name..". 'loot upload' / 'loot update' are ready.") else ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": auth failed (status "..tostring(status)..").") end end, nil, 30, nil, req) end
local function do_upload () if not (need_api() and need_auth()) then return end local body = serialize_db() local req = { method = "POST", source = body, headers = { ["content-type"] = "application/json", ["content-length"] = tostring(#body), ["x-api-key"] = auth_key() } } ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": uploading "..#body.." bytes...") async.doAsyncRemoteRequest(api_url().."/loot", function (rc, page, status) if status == 200 then ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": upload ok."..(page and page ~= "" and (" "..page) or "")) elseif status == 401 or status == 403 then ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": auth rejected -- run 'loot auth' again.") else ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": upload failed (status "..tostring(status)..").") end end, nil, 30, nil, req) end
local function do_update () if not (need_api() and need_auth()) then return end local req = { method = "GET", headers = { ["x-api-key"] = auth_key() } } ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": fetching the shared pool...") async.doAsyncRemoteRequest(api_url().."/loot", function (rc, page, status) if status == 200 and type(page) == "string" then local added, seen = merge_dump(page) ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": update ok -- "..added.." new row(s) ("..seen.." read).") elseif status == 401 or status == 403 then ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": auth rejected -- run 'loot auth' again.") else ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": update failed (status "..tostring(status)..").") end end, nil, 30, nil, req) end
function lt_cmd (arg) arg = trim(arg) local verb, rest = arg:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") verb = (verb or ""):lower()
if verb == "" or verb == "status" then ColourNote("cyan","", TITLE.." v"..PVER) ColourNote("white","", " loot rows : "..count_of("loot")) ColourNote("white","", " shop rows : "..count_of("shop_stock")) ColourNote("white","", " gathered : "..count_of("gathered")) ColourNote("white","", " goals : "..count_of("targets"))
elseif verb == "item" then show_item(rest) elseif verb == "mob" then show_mob(rest) elseif verb == "shop" then show_shop(rest) elseif verb == "gathered" or verb == "gather" then show_gathered(rest) elseif verb == "here" or verb == "ground" then local kw = trim(rest) if kw == "" then ColourNote("silver","","Usage: loot here <keyword> (picks it up and records the room spawn)"); return end here_pending = true EnableTrigger("here_catch", true) AddTimer("here_timeout", 0, 0, 3, "", timer_flag.Enabled + timer_flag.OneShot + timer_flag.Replace + timer_flag.Temporary, "here_timeout") Send("get " .. kw) elseif verb == "del" or verb == "forget" or verb == "remove" then del_item(rest) elseif verb == "bags" then show_bags(rest) elseif verb == "goals" or verb == "goal" then show_goals(rest) elseif verb == "recent" then show_recent() elseif verb == "export" then do_export(rest) elseif verb == "import" then do_import(rest) elseif verb == "auth" then do_auth() elseif verb == "upload" then do_upload() elseif verb == "update" then do_update() elseif verb == "api" then ColourNote("cyan","", TITLE..": API = "..(api_url() ~= "" and api_url() or "(disabled in this build)")) ColourNote("white","", " auth : "..(auth_key() ~= "" and ("yes, as "..(GetVariable("authname") or "?")) or "no -- run 'loot auth'"))
elseif verb == "clear" then if rest == "loot" then db:exec("DELETE FROM loot;"); ColourNote("green","","Loot table cleared.") elseif rest == "shop" then db:exec("DELETE FROM shop_stock;"); ColourNote("green","","Shop table cleared.") elseif rest == "gathered" then db:exec("DELETE FROM gathered;"); ColourNote("green","","Gathered table cleared.") elseif rest == "goals" then db:exec("DELETE FROM targets;"); ColourNote("green","","Goal targets cleared.") else ColourNote("silver","","Type 'loot clear loot|shop|gathered|goals'.") end
else ColourNote("cyan","", TITLE.." v"..PVER) for _, l in ipairs({ " loot - row counts", " loot item <text> - where an item drops from (mob / zone / room)", " loot mob <text> - what a mob drops", " loot shop <text> - which shops natively stock an item (price / zone)", " loot gathered <text> - where a room resource (bush/chest/...) is picked up", " loot here <keyword>- get a room-floor spawn and record its full name/colour", " loot del <item> [roomid] - remove matching rows (roomid scopes to one room)", " loot bags [add|del <word>] - container words ignored for gathers", " loot goals [text] - campaign/quest goal targets (mob -> area)", " loot recent - last 15 things looted", " loot export [file] - dump the DB to a file to share (no game traffic)", " loot import <file> - merge a shared export (existing rows kept)", " loot api - show the shared-API endpoint + your auth status", " loot auth - register this character with the pool (one time)", " loot upload - push your DB to the shared pool (needs auth)", " loot update - pull + merge the shared pool (needs auth)", " loot clear loot|shop|gathered|goals - wipe a table", " loot help - this", "Records every item you loot off a corpse, and native shop stock ('---'", "qty) when you 'list'. SolaoBot reads this DB for 'solbot item <name>'.", }) do ColourNote("white","", l) end end end
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- lifecycle ------------------------------------------------------------------ function OnPluginInstall () DBFILE = GetInfo(66) .. "SolaoLoot.db" load_exclude() local ok, err = pcall(opendb) if not ok then ColourNote("red","", TITLE..": could not open database -- "..tostring(err)) end end
function OnPluginClose () if db then db:close(); db = nil end end
